correctness.rationale: A diagonal phase gauge makes all weights nonnegative, also when some are zero. For any unit vector, taking componentwise absolute values bounds its numerical-radius Rayleigh expression by the quadratic form of the real symmetrization; a real top eigenvector gives equality. The square of the norm is the supremum of quadratics with common strict convexity modulus 2 sigma_min(W−I)^2>0, since W is nilpotent. At zero the top eigenvalue starts fully degenerate, giving right slope 2(ν−1). At one, write t=1−δ. The first-order perturbation of W*W is δ(W+W*−2W*W); its compression to the top eigenspace has diagonal −2M² and off-diagonal M only between consecutive maximal source indices. The longest of those paths has L vertices, so the compressed top eigenvalue is 2M(c_L−M). To justify using the compression even at a tie, decompose a trial unit vector into that eigenspace and a complement of norm b. The unperturbed loss is at least gap·b² and the cross-term is O(δ b), giving only O(δ²) excess over the compressed first-order maximum; a unit vector in the eigenspace attains that expansion from below. Thus the left slope at one is 2M(M−c_L). Convexity gives the stated three regimes, including equality at either endpoint and strict improvement at an interior minimizer. The cases cannot conflict because ν≤M and c_L<1. For t>1, testing on a maximal source vector gives norm at least sqrt((t−1)²+t²M²)>M, so the optimum persists on t≥0; negative t could not improve the objective either since the spectral radius there exceeds 1. The displayed change of variable maps the physical interval to [0,1+a], giving the claimed scaled optimum.
residual_risks: The optional diagnostic replay is python check.py with NumPy and SciPy. The supplied script does numeric optimization and checks an analogous, nonidentical rearrangement pair. Contrary to the broader description at RESULT.md line 66, it contains no rational finite-difference slope check. This does not affect the endpoint claims, which follow from the exact eigenspace compression, not the numerical test.

value.rationale: The spectral-radius optimum cannot distinguish weights at all, but the exact worst-case one-pass optimum can differ for two arrangements of the same weight multiset. The theorem identifies which dependence is purely a longest-run obstruction at the nilpotent endpoint and which needs the numerical radius. This provides a useful classification for one-lag transfer without computing the full norm curve.
residual_risks: No closed form for the interior parameter and no extension to multi-tap or general PDE waveform operators is credited.
